Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1366
Claimant:
Phillip Garza
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2024-03-31
Claim repotred by the insured's representing attorney's office following a rear-end collision at a signalized
intersection. The insured vehicle was struck from behind while stopped, and the claimant reports neck pain and
whiplash symptoms.
2024-04-02
Confirmed the driver of the insured vehicle is named on the policy and that coverage was active at the time of loss.
Polciy records show no lapse or recent changes that wolud affect this claim.
2024-04-06
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and notes the rear impact.
Responding officers recorded the vehicle positions but no independent witnesses were identified.
2024-04-24
Received scene and vehicle photographs from the claimant. They confirm the general location of the impact and the
rear damage, though they do not show every detail the claimant describes.
2024-04-27
Reviewed the vehicle appraisal. Damage appears consistent with a rear impact of this type, but it is not yet clear
whether all of the listed damage resulted from this collision. A supplemental inspection has been requested.
2024-06-21
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who provided the medical file. The reported whiplash injury is a kind that fits the
force and direction of this impact, and no earlier injury to the same body area is known from the records provided.
2024-06-27
Recorded the claimant's statement through counsel. It added some minor details not mentioned at first notice, but the
core account of the collision has stayed the same across each telling.
2024-07-05
Reviewed the treatment records. Care followed a usual course of physical therapy and medication, and the claimant's
symptoms eased steadily as treatment progressed.
2024-07-07
Checked prior claims and vehicle history for the insured vehicle. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on record, and
nothing suggests any of the damage predates the start of coverage.
2024-08-14
Requested the claimant's remaining treatment and billing records through counsel. Updated the reserve to reflect the
current treatment status and the pending supplemental vehicle inspection.
2024-09-10
Discussed status with the claimant's attorney. Treatment has tapered as the claimant improved, and the file will
remain open pending receipt of the final billing records and the supplemental inspection report.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
